name: fmt-14
src: (-nosound only disables output; Play and folder listing still run)
note: combat.mi = stock copy + one start trigger playing four names in order: mp3-only folder, ogg-only folder, wav folder (control), missing folder (end marker). Pass: mp3/ogg names warn as unknown exactly like a missing folder, wav name does not, so only .wav is registered. Log check only, runs under -nosound. [T] the trigger runs with its empty condition (stock 'environment' has the same form). [T] whether the VFS indexes .mp3/.ogg at all: same verdict either way. Does not cover the row's stereo 3D claim, audible silence, or a .mp3 name used with extension.
